def get_total_amount(c):
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', c)
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else None

        yr_in=re.search(r'([12][0-9]{3})-\d{2}-\d{2}', c)
        # We may have single year occurrences; verify billing duration start

        total=get_total_amount(c)
        # month-year extract
        m=re.search(r'duration\s*=>\s*([12][0-9]{3})-(\d{2})-\d{2}', c, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        month_key=None
        if m:
            month_key=f"{m.group(1)}-{m.group(2)}"
        # filter current year either from filename or duration start year

        if start_year==year or (f'/ {year}-' in f):

            if m and int(m.group(1))==year:
